title: Mytra, which is building autonomous robots for warehouses that can move loads up to 3,000 pounds, raised a $120M Series C led by Avenir Growth (Allie Garfinkle/Fortune)
summary: Allie Garfinkle / Fortune: Mytra, which is building autonomous robots for warehouses that can move loads up to 3,000 pounds, raised a $120M Series C led by Avenir Growth — Senior Finance Reporter And Author Of Term Sheet — Mytra's Chris Walti (L) and Ahmad Baitalmal (R).MYTRA — Chris Walti once led engineering for Tesla's humanoid Optimus.
contentText:
Allie Garfinkle / Fortune :

Mytra, which is building autonomous robots for warehouses that can move loads up to 3,000 pounds, raised a $120M Series C led by Avenir Growth   —  Senior Finance Reporter And Author Of Term Sheet  —  Mytra's Chris Walti (L) and Ahmad Baitalmal (R).MYTRA  —  Chris Walti once led engineering for Tesla's humanoid Optimus.
